key_impacts: Reactor units at Fukushima Daiichi were damaged, necessitating long-term decommissioning.
Large volumes of contaminated water generated; about 1,100,000 m3 of ALPS-treated water stored on-site by Oct 2018.
Site conditions transitioned from an emergency to a stabilized state.
Preparations for removal of spent fuel from Unit 3 pool advanced; work progressing for Units 1 and 2.
Fuel debris deposits identified in Units 1–3; PCV investigations ongoing.
